description.zh:
返回结果显示的语言。取值：

- zh-CN：中文

- en-US（默认值）：英文
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese

- en-US (default): English

description.zh: 地址池的ID，地址池的唯一识别码。
description.en: The unique ID of the address pool.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client. The token can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters in length.

description.zh: 传入的参数作为更新后的备注，传空值则删除备注。
description.en: The new remarks for the address pool. If you leave this parameter empty, the remarks are deleted.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns update-cloud-gtm-address-pool-remark --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --address-pool-id pool-895280232254420000 --remark test --region cn-hangzhou
